tasks.label: Build hmctest
tasks.command: mkdir -p build && cd build && cmake .. -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=/usr/local/opt/llvm/bin/clang -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=/usr/local/opt/llvm/bin/clang++ -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DBEAGLE_DEBUG_VALUES=ON -DBEAGLE_DEBUG_FLOW=ON -DBUILD_OPENMP=ON && make hmctest VERBOSE=1

tasks.label: Build stochastictest
tasks.command: mkdir -p build && cd build && cmake .. -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=/usr/local/opt/llvm/bin/clang -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=/usr/local/opt/llvm/bin/clang++ -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DBEAGLE_DEBUG_VALUES=ON -DBEAGLE_DEBUG_FLOW=ON -DBUILD_OPENMP=ON && make stochastictest VERBOSE=1

mkdir -p build && cd build && cmake .. -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=/usr/local/opt/llvm/bin/clang -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=/usr/local/opt/llvm/bin/clang++ -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS='-fsanitize=address -g' -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS='-fsanitize=address -g' -DBEAGLE_DEBUG_VALUES=ON -DBEAGLE_DEBUG_FLOW=ON -DBUILD_OPENMP=ON && make stochastictest VERBOSE=1

tasks.label: CMake Configure
tasks.command: cd ${workspaceFolder} && mkdir -p build && cd build && cmake .. -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DBEAGLE_DEBUG_VALUES=ON -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD=17

tasks.label: Full Rebuild
tasks.command: cd ${workspaceFolder} && mkdir -p build && cd build && cmake .. -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DBEAGLE_DEBUG_VALUES=ON -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD=17 && make
